svg.title: CASTAWAY: an early DOS VGA loader screen
svg.desc: ANOTHER LONG WAIT FROM IDLE HANDS. CASTAWAY in chrome capitals (sky over a strip of sea over sand) on a grey bevelled plate, over palette-cycled blue diamonds, with a hammock made of the words "EVERY SO OFTEN, SOMETHING HAPPENS" and a young woman lying in it, nodding to her headphones. A giant scroller below.
